**agentic-wireless-manager v1.0.1 — Initial Public Release**

- Initial release as "agentic-wireless-manager" skill, implementing AI-powered wireless diagnostics and management powered by SAC-LTC reasoning.
- Added comprehensive documentation, including README, CONTRIBUTING, detailed architecture, permissions, and command guides.
- Provided sample data files for environment, episodes, and training logs, along with core scripts to scan, train, and run the agent locally.
- Implements full single-skill reproduction of the original repository’s features: Wi-Fi diagnostics, intelligent hotspot switching, explainable RF environment analysis, presence sensing, and navigation support.
- Prioritizes privacy and user consent; requires explicit user approval for any disruptive or privileged operation.
- Supports local-first, cross-platform operation with fallback to deterministic heuristics if advanced dependencies are unavailable.

A lightweight AI agent that runs alongside your agentic AI, continuously monitoring and optimizing the wireless environment using SAC-LTC (Soft Actor-Critic with Liquid Time-Constant cells) — a neural architecture that adapts its temporal reasoning speed to match real-world wireless dynamics.
